page.overview:
Who is Coach?

Coach is a yellow Cheep Cheep character featured in Mario Party Advance.

He works at the Mushroom Pool in Seaside Area, where he provides swimming lessons. One of his students is named Cheep Cheep, who is not confident in his swimming skills. In the quest Swimmin' Wimp, player's character is put in a swim race against the Cheep Cheep, with the goal being to allow the Cheep Cheep to win while still putting in effort in on their end. Once this is done, the Coach proudly gives the player the Desktop Golf Gaddget as a reward.
